candidate_hypotheses_ranked.physical_signature: Multi-scale directional disagreement D_sigma = ||grad_sigma z_base|| * (1 - cos angle(grad_sigma z_base, grad_sigma z_surf)) at sigma in {1, 3, 6} px (100 m, 300 m, 600 m), antithetic step ||grad_3 z_base|| * (1 + cos angle), cross-strike vector cross product ||grad_3 z_base|| * |sin angle|, low-slope buried basement step ||grad_3 z_base|| / (1 + det_elev_slope / median(det_elev_slope)), gravity-cover admittance, and transtensional strain-conductivity coupling.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.why_off_catalogue: USGS/INGENIOUS fault compilations map faults primarily where surface scarps break Quaternary alluvium (high det_elev_slope). Intra-basin horst-bounding faults, step-over relays beneath 10-100 m of post-faulting alluvial/playa fill, and antithetic basin-floor faults lack surface topographic scarps and are systematically omitted from existing_faults.tif, yet produce sharp gradients in sedimentary cover thickness (Band 15) whose orientation decouples from surface slope (Band 12).
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.named_non_fault_mimic: Alluvial-fan toe radial onlap against an unfaulted bedrock pediment or incised paleochannel edge, plus closed-basin playa evaporite collars. Suppressed via explicit planform radial curvature penalty (qts_mimic_fan_curv).
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.difference_from_existing_repo: MDC-88 used scalar gradient magnitudes g1_z_base and g3_z_base without directional vector decoupling against surface slope; H88-ADHR back-projected gradients up a 60-degree dip toward range-front scarps and relied on 22 catalogue-derived visible-fault relay features; PROVCREST weighted surface slope (Band 19) at 45%; TILTZERO, MRR-BPR-88, and KTH-88 used magnetic/gravity/radiometric ratios without cover-thickness directional decoupling.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.expected_dti_improvement: Statistically significant positive HOLDOUT-DTI lift (+0.005 to +0.006 on 19-band OOF PU) while satisfying the >=35% far-field (d_cat > 25 px) blind-basin fleet fingerprint screen.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.implementation_cost: Low (uses hash-pinned 19-band training_features.tif already in workspace; <60 s compute).

candidate_hypotheses_ranked.title: Cross-Drainage Chi-Disequilibrium & Normalized Channel Steepness Reversal
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.physical_signature: Opposite-flank signed chi divide-asymmetry step across strike paired with k_sn knickpoint concentration.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.why_off_catalogue: Eroded or blind range-front step-overs that no longer preserve a sharp surface scarp still perturb drainage divide migration (delta chi) and align knickzones across adjacent catchments.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.named_non_fault_mimic: Differential lithologic resistance (silicified welded tuff caprock over softer lacustrine beds) or Pleistocene pluvial lake base-level fall knickpoints.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.difference_from_existing_repo: Prior lanes used raw chi magnitude; this targets signed cross-divide chi reversal paired with k_sn steps.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.expected_dti_improvement: +0.002 to +0.004 in upland/piedmont bedrock corridors; zero signal in flat playas where chan_n == 0.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.implementation_cost: Low-Medium (derived 100 m summary rasters are hash-pinned locally; raw 10 m USGS 3DEP tiles are blocked by sandbox firewall).

candidate_hypotheses_ranked.title: Scale-Selective Multi-Physics Structure-Tensor Azimuth Coherence
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.physical_signature: Circular resultant length kappa(x) = ||(1/4) sum_{m=1..4} (cos 2*theta_m, sin 2*theta_m)|| of dominant structure-tensor orientations across shallow, intermediate, and deep potential fields at 300 m scale.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.why_off_catalogue: Crustal-scale geothermal feeder faults cut basement, Tertiary volcanics, and Quaternary fill, aligning the strike of gravity, magnetic, and basement-depth gradients even when surface expression is muted.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.named_non_fault_mimic: Unfaulted tilted fault-block dip slopes or regional granitic batholith contacts where bedding/contact strike is coherent across depth without brittle fault offset.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.difference_from_existing_repo: fabric_dislocation measured magnetic-only bilateral rotation; SSA-88 measures 4-modality axial strike coherence.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.expected_dti_improvement: +0.002 to +0.004 on multi-kilometer blind transfer structures.

candidate_hypotheses_ranked.title: Elevation-Detrended Electrical Conductivity Upflow Residual
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.physical_signature: Local 5 km windowed regression residual of log(1 + cond_surf) on elevation and pluvial shoreline indicators, isolating high-elevation range-front/piedmont smectite clay-cap alteration from basin-floor evaporite brines.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.why_off_catalogue: Blind hydrothermal upflow zones alter host rock to electrically conductive smectite/illite along unmapped range-front step-overs above the valley floor.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.named_non_fault_mimic: Perched lacustrine clay beds or conductive altered ash-flow tuff horizons along range flanks.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.difference_from_existing_repo: CGO-88 and MDC-88 used raw cond_surf and |grad log(cond_surf)|; CAL-88 explicitly regresses out local elevation to separate upflow conduits from playa brines.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.expected_dti_improvement: +0.001 to +0.003 around active hydrothermal upflow cells.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.implementation_cost: Medium (local windowed OLS residual across 5.17M pixels).
